doc: Detection duties of the observation-driven runtime. Each is a producer (the only polling), a signal with max_age, and a resolver role. `replaces` names the retired detector units. Exit codes: 0 GREEN, 2 RED, anything else a failed observation that ages to UNKNOWN.

duties.name: ci
duties.covers: GitHub Actions result for the remote commit

duties.name: dispatch
duties.covers: a wake left open (started/unknown) longer than 30 minutes

duties.name: egress
duties.covers: tailscale exit-node egress for each client

duties.name: guard-bytes
duties.covers: installed host guard bytes equal the reviewed target

duties.name: restore-readiness
duties.covers: the host can restore the plant

duties.name: observer-checks
duties.covers: the observer check inventory

duties.name: omp-db
duties.covers: omp agent database integrity

duties.name: devto
duties.covers: DEV.to threads observed and delivered

duties.name: budget
duties.covers: token and quota windows; RED or UNKNOWN holds spontaneous wakes

duties.name: host-capacity
duties.covers: memory/CPU/IO pressure and anon split, admission for optional work

duties.name: delivery-requests
duties.covers: a delivery admission held by a dead owner, or a delivery request left UNKNOWN; observed between wakes, not only at consume

duties.name: tape-lock
duties.covers: the plant-wide tape/task lock can be taken; a stuck holder blocks every wall, task and tape write

duties.name: readings
duties.covers: bounded acquisition of the retained Senses inventory; source-specific unknowns stay visible, failed/missing/stale scans remain UNKNOWN

duties.name: view-readability
duties.covers: every role's top and bottom pane renders as human-readable text: no JSON, dict reprs, escaped newlines, raw epoch numbers or private paths; unrenderable or missing views stay UNKNOWN

duties.name: push-lag
duties.covers: local main reaches GitHub within two hours: RED when the oldest unpushed commit is older, or main has diverged; UNKNOWN when the remote cannot be read

duties.name: next-due-armed
duties.covers: due-time wakes are armed: RED when the recorded next due time passed more than five minutes ago with no mishe-next-due timer, or the units-installed marker is missing; UNKNOWN when next-due.json or systemd cannot be read

duties.name: work-trial
duties.covers: Bounded useful-work 6h/24h reports and retained final checkpoint validity; corrupt or interrupted evidence stays UNKNOWN.

duties.name: work-watch
duties.covers: Deterministic evidence/deadline sweep independent of next-due rearming; failure or missing sweep output remains UNKNOWN within three minutes.

duties.name: audio-hint-livingroom
duties.covers: living-room microphone hint window: one row per cadence; UNKNOWN when the mic or transcriber fails

duties.name: audio-listener-coverage
duties.covers: resident living-room listener heartbeat: GREEN when its status is fresh and at least half of wall time is observed, RED under 50 %, UNKNOWN when the status is stale, missing, stopped, restarting, suspended or warming up

duties.name: voice-clone-ready
duties.covers: voice.clone.ready: clone model file, mesh-voice-clone unit, daemon socket and a no-sound synthesis probe, with bounded self-healing

duties.name: household-camera-livingroom
duties.covers: living-room webcam brightness grid, one row every 150 s (kept under the unit start budget); a blind lens (covered, dark or flat) is status blind, recorded and exits 2 (RED, observed); the V4L2 input held by another process on every bounded attempt exits 4 (UNKNOWN, input missing, unit succeeds); any other failed capture exits 1 (crash)

duties.name: household-camera-bedroom
duties.covers: bedroom Mac camera brightness grid every four minutes; a blind lens is status blind, recorded and exits 2 (RED, observed); an unreachable Mac exits 4 (UNKNOWN, input missing, unit succeeds); a local crash or config error exits 1 (crash)

duties.name: household-phones
duties.covers: Note3 sensor sample and Redmi10 stream freshness with raw light and accelerometer; a stale or missing phone exits UNKNOWN

duties.name: household-daylight
duties.covers: per-room daylight curve (UTC hour median luma, lamp steps removed) rebuilt from signatures.jsonl every ten minutes; no usable signature rows or a crash exits UNKNOWN (never an empty GREEN curve), an hour without ok samples stays null

duties.name: household-activity
duties.covers: household activity.json every ten minutes: 15-min per-room change buckets, lights events, the quiet block and the rhythm line (provisional, not validated), plus hourly audio level; no ok signature rows exits UNKNOWN

duties.name: rust-plan-progress
duties.covers: the rust-plan investigation is making progress: its canonical wall exists and is inside its bound, and the plan document is present and non-empty; a missing or stale wall is RED, an unreadable observation is UNKNOWN, and a producer that stops running ages the signal to UNKNOWN

duties.name: network-probe
duties.covers: home connectivity: gateway and public-resolver latency and loss, DNS and HTTPS timing (rows in network/probe.jsonl); RED when the internet is unreachable, UNKNOWN when the probe cannot run

duties.name: network-speed
duties.covers: the bounded download speed reading (rows in network/speed.jsonl): one 5 MB download, only 02-05 local and at most every 12 h; UNKNOWN when the last attempt failed, RED when the duty itself cannot run

duties.name: network-window
duties.covers: the outer tmux window plants:network exists and runs tools/network_view.py; RED when missing or dead, RED when the running copy of the view differs from the view's files on disk (or it never reported its copy) with the exact respawn command, UNKNOWN when tmux or git cannot be read

duties.name: network-progress
duties.covers: the network mind keeps improving network visibility: its wall is under six hours old and network files were committed within 48 hours; RED when it has gone quiet, UNKNOWN when git cannot be read

duties.name: wake-waste
duties.covers: wakes that did real work and were thrown away: a wake in the last two hours ended by timeout, or without a yield after a stream of a megabyte or more; RED names role, model, outcome, minutes and size so the resolver fixes timeout policy, wake scope or engine use; UNKNOWN when the routing ledger cannot be read

duties.name: human-inbound-relayed
duties.covers: the human's own inbound lines reach the operator chat: the mishe-human-inbound-relay timer relays each new line of voice-in.log from a byte cursor; RED when an unrelayed human line is older than the limit (relay stopped), UNKNOWN when the log, cursor or voice receiver cannot be read; this duty only observes, the timer does the relay

duties.name: sonnet-ban
duties.covers: the human's Sonnet ban (Ilya 2026-11-10, until the Claude weekly reset ~03:00Z 2026-11-11): RED when a live engine config, a routes.json candidate or a recent (6 h) routing-ledger selection names a Sonnet model a wake could use or used, UNKNOWN when the configs or ledger cannot be read; retire the duty when Ilya lifts the ban

retired.why: pane/tmux liveness and the core supervisor's own observer; there are no panes and no resident supervisor
replaced by the owed check, due intentions and the next-due timer; a role that stops being woken shows as an open or aged dispatch
no resident runtime can lag the checkout; a wake pins its release at start and doctor compares installed units with the pin
role residents; roles remain as registry data and are woken by trigger

the recovery runtime's incident outbox and evaluation reported to resident minds; pressure is now the host-capacity signal and failures route through mishe-failed. recovery_io remains as manual tooling (accept/evaluate), not as units

kept.why: cross-site sync follower; links to other plants and is outside this runtime's scope
